notes: App-wide configuration. store_url opens from locked course cards. redemption_codes is a CLIENT-SIDE STUB for the MVP — any code in this list unlocks all paid courses; replace with server-side validation before real sales. instructor_codes unlock the hidden Instructor Dashboard: type one into the 'What do you want to learn or shoot?' field on the home screen. site_access_code locks the whole published app: every device enters it once (backend rejects unauthenticated writes without it).
